from glom.core import Coalesce, glom
from glom.mutation import assign

target = {
    'profile': {'name': 'Ada', 'nickname': '', 'handles': {'github': 'ada-l'}},
    'settings': {},
}
primary = glom(target, Coalesce('profile.alias', 'profile.nickname', 'profile.handles.github', skip=''))
assign(target, 'settings.primary', primary, missing=dict)
assign(target, 'settings.length', len(primary), missing=dict)

print(primary)
print(target['settings'])
print(target)
